records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:157 — Calendar updates use the caller’s credentials instead of the booking organizer’s, preventing reliable updates when an attendee adds guests.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue. In addGuests.handler.ts line 158, `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` fetches credentials for the requesting user (ctx.user), not the booking organizer. The EventManager is then initialized with these credentials at line 160-163. When an attendee (who has permission via isAttendee check at line 49) adds guests, the calendar update at line 165 `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` would use the attendee's credentials instead of the organizer's credentials.
